source_chain_rechecked.exit: worker_lifecycle.c::NtvdmAuthorizeExit -> ntvdm_worker_lifecycle_authorize_exit -> request worker close / wait server authorization / quiesce. Four wkman callers authorize before ExitVDM; folding into later ExitProcess changes ordering.
source_chain_rechecked.identity: wkman binds original iTask and HTASK; wow_task_termination.c stores server ticket -> lifecycle.c::BindWowTask authenticates worker and resolves original WOWRECORD or pending label. Retire clears bound/close state and local mapping. Fail clears close-requested for original user-cancel/missing-task paths without completing task.
source_chain_rechecked.idle: wow_user_task_lifecycle.c installs per-thread WH_FOREGROUNDIDLE and owns UnhookWindowsHookEx. wkman borrows handle. wow_idle_hook_binding.c enters task callback and USER borrow scopes before original callback and leaves before native CallNextHookEx. Direct original registration lacks these scopes; restoring original unhook duplicates ownership.
source_chain_rechecked.cleanup: wow_task_cleanup_entry.c::W32FreeTask runs wow_user_task_prepare_exit before original resource/DC/timer/socket cleanup. Original body remains; remote and incomplete-startup paths do not necessarily issue SG_EXIT.
source_chain_rechecked.startup: Duplicate WOWEXEC skips original InitTask. wow_user_notify_startup_noop latches exact iTask startup before original ExitVDM. run16 wait_wow_startup otherwise maps zero completion without started flag to DLL_INIT_FAILED.
source_chain_rechecked.headers: Reused historical actual compiler controls: missing local _X86_ yields C1189; original ntseapi.h supplied explicitly yields SDK C2011 conflicts. Header omission is not justified merely by file lookup failure.
